formal_baseline: original LLaDA low-confidence, 128 steps, generation length 256, block length 32
accuracy_parent: trajectory_confirmed_bidirectional_block v9 with symmetric_fast tau=0.004 parent
objective: Reduce v9 NFE and wall time while preserving its selected token sequence exactly.

method.horizontal: Keep the same symmetric_fast trajectory and the same conservative attention trajectory used by v9.
method.longitudinal: Accumulate conservative committed-token log probability during denoising and use a zero-log-loss optimistic upper bound for all still-uncommitted positions.
method.safe_abort: If accumulated_logprob / generation_length is already at most fast_mean + 1/block_length, even perfect remaining tokens cannot satisfy v9's strict path-evidence gate; stop the conservative trajectory and return fast without block verification.
method.selection_when_not_aborted: Run the unchanged v9 bidirectional block verifier and unchanged fast-tie selection.

invariants.output: Must be byte-for-byte identical to v9 for every evaluated prompt.
invariants.nfe: Must never exceed v9 NFE for the same prompt.
invariants.fallback: Any invariant violation rejects v10 and leaves v9 unchanged.

validation.unit: Optimistic-bound arithmetic and an integration test proving verifier skipping and fast return.
validation.real_model_gate: Fresh isolated HumanEval run, first on a small prefix and then full paired output comparison against v9; compare stable task id and prompt hash.
validation.accuracy_promotion: No independent accuracy claim; v10 inherits an accuracy result only after exact-output equivalence is demonstrated.
